content: The brand was established by José Pepin Garcia and is produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. The brand features two distinct product lines: the Cuban Diplomat and the Cuban Diplomat Corojo Rosado. The Cuban Diplomat line comprises five vitolas. It utilizes the same filler and binder as the Havana Soul cigars but is wrapped in a Connecticut shade wrapper. This combination creates a medium to full-bodied cigar. The band is red and features an image of a tobacco field surrounded by a broad border. These cigars are packaged in boxes containing 25 units. The Cuban Diplomat Corojo Rosado line consists of four vitolas. Like the Cuban Diplomat, it uses the same filler and binder as the Havana Soul cigars, but the wrapper is a rosado Corojo leaf. This results in a medium to full-bodied cigar with a richer flavor profile. The band design is similar to that of the Cuban Diplomat line. These cigars are also packaged in boxes of 25.
